why: The builder brief carries none of the verifier's checks. Step 4 runs only commands named by the expect lines and proofs ("printf 'a\tb\n1\t2\n' | node bin/csv2json.js --tsv; echo \"exit=$?\"") plus npm test, which is allowed. Step 2 tells the builder to write its own tests, using inputs and outputs from expect lines 1–3 and 5, also allowed. The verifier's own probes appear nowhere in the builder brief: "printf ... | cmp - /tmp/o1 && echo SAME", cat -A, od -c, "grep -rn -- '--tsv' test/" and the "node bin/csv2json.js foo --tsv" position check. Its PASS/FAIL conditions are also absent, for example "FAIL ... the test only calls parse() directly". The builder gets the bar, not the checker's methods.
